name: Kon'ya, Tsuma ga Chichi ni Dakaremasu... ~Iwabuchi Haruka no Kokuhaku~
original_name: 今夜、妻が父に抱かれます…　～岩淵遥の告白～
source: Haruka married Takeru who she had always thought of as a younger brother. Once they confessed their feelings to each other, they realized they had been in love for a long time. They got married and were happy, receiving blessings from family and friends. However, her husband got involved in workplace trouble, which caused a ripple in their relationship. As her husband became busier, she spent more time with her father-in-law, leading to an incident one night.
translation: 遥嫁给了一直将她视为弟弟的武。当他们向对方坦白自己的感情后，他们才意识到自己已经相爱很久了。他们结婚了，幸福美满，得到了家人和朋友的祝福。然而，丈夫却卷入了职场风波，两人的感情出现了波澜。随着丈夫越来越忙，她陪伴公公的时间也越来越多，结果有一天晚上发生了一件事情。
